mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_DAILY_STAT (DAY, METRIC, KEY, CNT) VALUES (#{day}, #{metric}, #{key}, #{cnt}) ON CONFLICT (DAY, METRIC, KEY) DO UPDATE SET CNT = T_DAILY_STAT.CNT + EXCLUDED.CNT
INSERT INTO T_DAILY_VISITOR (DAY, VID) VALUES (#{day}, #{v}) ON CONFLICT (DAY, VID) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_DAILY_STAT WHERE DAY < CURRENT_DATE - 90
DELETE FROM T_DAILY_VISITOR WHERE DAY < CURRENT_DATE - 90
mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(D.DAY, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "day" ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_DAILY_VISITOR V WHERE V.DAY = D.DAY)::INT AS "visitors" ,(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(S.CNT), 0) FROM T_DAILY_STAT S WHERE S.DAY = D.DAY AND S.METRIC = 'PV')::INT AS "pv" FROM GENERATE_SERIES((NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::DATE - (#{days} - 1), (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::DATE, INTERVAL '1 day') AS D(DAY) ORDER BY D.DAY
SELECT KEY AS "key" ,SUM(CNT)::INT AS "pv" FROM T_DAILY_STAT WHERE 1=1 AND METRIC = 'PV' AND DAY > (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::DATE - #{days} GROUP BY KEY ORDER BY SUM(CNT) DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT KEY AS "key" ,SUM(CNT)::INT AS "cnt" FROM T_DAILY_STAT WHERE 1=1 AND METRIC = 'EVENT' AND DAY > (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::DATE - #{days} GROUP BY KEY

SELECT TO_CHAR((U.INS_DAY AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "day" ,COUNT(*)::INT AS "signups" FROM T_USER U WHERE 1=1 AND COALESCE(U.PROVIDER, '') NOT IN ('AI', 'DEMO') AND U.INS_DAY >= NOW() - (#{days} || ' days')::INTERVAL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
